concerns.location: plan.md: Phase 0 – Setup & Synthetic Video Generation, step d/e
concerns.text: The pipeline filters counterfactual pairs using **cosine similarity ≥ 0.9** between frozen FlowNet‑C feature vectors (the same backbone later used as the model’s feature extractor). Selecting pairs that already exhibit high feature similarity may bias the training data toward examples that are trivially easy for the downstream linear classifier, potentially inflating the observed ΔAcc improvement. This creates a subtle data‑leakage / selection bias, which could compromise the validity of the claimed robustness gains.
